description: Read-only: full public config for one catalog model by slug. When to use: after list_models to confirm modes, qualities, and options. Cost: free. ai-influencer: first call lists tiers; pass tier (and category) for catalog detail before generate_character_sheet. genjutsu: presets=true adds restyle preset ids. Returns: model payload (no user data).

category.description: ai-influencer category filter when using tier.
category.title: Category

model_id.description: Catalog model slug from list_models (e.g. soul-2, hailuo-2-3).
model_id.title: Model Id

presets.description: genjutsu only: include restyle preset identifiers in the response.
presets.title: Presets

tier.description: ai-influencer tier key when expanding that model.
tier.title: Tier
